title: Unicast, Broadcast & Multicast
description: Understand the three types of traffic: unicast, broadcast, and multicast.
scenario: Understand the three types of traffic: unicast, broadcast, and multicast.

concepts.title: Unicast
concepts.body: One-to-one communication. The frame has a specific destination MAC. Switches forward unicast frames to one port.

concepts.title: Broadcast
concepts.body: One-to-all communication. Destination is FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF. Switches flood broadcasts out all ports in the VLAN.
concepts.code:
ARP request: broadcast
Dst MAC: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF

concepts.title: Multicast
concepts.body: One-to-many communication. Destination is a multicast MAC (01:00:5E:xx:xx:xx). Switches flood multicast like broadcast.
